BESSEL FUNCTIONS OF FRACTIONAL ORDER (p.438)
10.1.10  j_n(z)=f_n(z) \sin z+(-1)^{n+1}f_{-n-1}(z) \cos z
f_0(z)=z^{-1}, \qquad f_1(z)=z^{-2}
f_{n-1}(z)+f_{n+1}(z)=(2n+1)z^{-1}f_n(z) \quad (n=0, \pm1, \pm2, \dots)
The Functions j_n(z), y_n(z) for n=0, 1, 2
10.1.11  j_0(z)=\frac{\sin z}{z}
j_1(z)=\frac{\sin z}{z^2}-\frac{\cos z}{z}
j_2(z)=\left(\frac{3}{z^2}-\frac{1}{z}\right) \sin z-\frac{3}{z^2} \cos z
10.1.12  y_0(z)=-j_{-1}(z)=-\frac{\cos z}{z}
y_1(z)=j_{-2}(z)=-\frac{\cos z}{z^2}-\frac{\sin z}{z}
y_2(z)=-j_{-3}(z)=\left(-\frac{3}{z^2}+\frac{1}{z}\right) \cos z-\frac{3}{z^2} \sin z

Poisson's Integral and Gegenbauer's Generalization
10.1.13  j_n(z)=\frac{z^n}{2^{n+1}n!}\int_0^\pi \cos (z \cos \theta) \sin^{2n+1}\theta\,d\theta
(See 9.1.20.)
10.1.14  =\frac{1}{2} (-i)^n\int_0^\pi e^{iz \cos \theta}P_n(\cos \theta) \sin \theta\,d\theta \quad (n=0, 1, 2, \dots)
note: Mixed formula + figure page (Ch.10 spherical Bessel functions). Three plotted figures (10.1-10.3) whose curves are not transcribable text -- captions kept as structural content, plots marked [FIGURE]. NOTE: 10.1.11's j_2 and 10.1.12's y_2 are printed with 3/z^2 where the mathematically correct coefficient is 3/z^3 -- a typo in the 1964 printing. Verified at 3x magnification and transcribed AS PRINTED: gold measures OCR reading accuracy, so silently fixing the source would score a correct read as wrong.
